questions.question: A car travels from A to B at 44 km/hr and returns from B to A at 66 km/hr. Find its average speed during the whole journey.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For equal distances, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y)

Here, x = 44 km/hr and y = 66 km/hr

Average Speed = (2 × 44 × 66) ÷ (44 + 66)

Average Speed = 5808 ÷ 110 = 52.8 km/hr

**∴ The correct option is B.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Speed from A to B = 44 km/hr, Speed from B to A = 66 km/hr

Formula: Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 
•

• 
 

 Going: 44 km/hr
 Returning: 66 km/hr

⇒ Let the distance between A and B be the LCM of 44 and 66 = 132 km

⇒ Time taken to travel from A to B = 132 ÷ 44 = 3 hours

⇒ Time taken to travel from B to A = 132 ÷ 66 = 2 hours

⇒ Total distance covered = 132 + 132 = 264 km

⇒ Total time taken = 3 + 2 = 5 hours

⇒ Average speed = 264 ÷ 5 = 52.8 km/hr

**∴ The correct option is B.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

The general formula is Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time, used when speeds or distances vary.

Harmonic Mean for Equal Distance

When a journey is divided into n equal distance parts with speeds v₁, v₂...vₙ, average speed is the harmonic mean of these speeds.

Speed Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: A man alone can do a piece of work in 16 days, but with the help of his friend, he can do it in 8 days. In what time can his friend do it alone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man can complete the work in = 16 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the friend alone can complete the work in X days

A man's one-day work = {1over 16}

Friend's one day work = {1over X}

According to the question

⇒ {1over 16}+{1over X}={1over8}

⇒ {1over X}={1over 8}-{1over 16}

⇒ {1over X}={2-1over 16}

⇒ X = 16 days

The friend alone can complete the work in = 16 days

**∴ The required result will be 16 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__Their ratio of efficiency when they worked together and man's efficiency = 16 : 8 = 2 : 1

The efficiency of friend = 2 - 1 = 1 

The efficiency of a friend is equal to the efficiency of a man then friend also can complete the work in 16 days

∴ The required result will be 16 days.

questions.question: In a rectangle, diagonal is 4 times of its breadth. The ratio of length to breadth is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diagonal is 4 times its breadth.

**Concept:**

Length and breadth are different in rectangles.

**Formula used:**

Pythagorean theorem for rectangle

Diagonal² = Length² + breadth²

**Calculation:**

Let the breadth of the rectangle is B

The diagonal of the rectangle = 4B

The length of the rectangle 

⇒ Length² = (4B)² - B² = 16B² - B² = 15B²

⇒ Length = √15B

The ratio of length and breadth = √15B : B = √15 : 1

**∴ The required result will be √15 : 1.**

The pie chart given below shows the number of trucks manufactured by six companies in a year. Total trucks manufactured by all these six companies are 1440. Number of trucks manufactured by a particular company is shown in terms of degree with respect to the total number of trucks manufactured by all these six companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1442a4f5915be3df6b2af65276973cf9f27a82ad62ece78dfc1309db1bc8793.png] 

What is difference between the average number of trucks manufactured by K and P and the average number of trucks manufactured by J and M?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total trucks manufactured by all six companies are = 1440

The manufactured by K = 108° 

The manufactured by P = 45° 

The manufactured by J = 55° 

The manufactured by M = 18° 

**Concept:**

They have divided production in degree = 360° = 1440

**Formula used:**

{Average} = {The sum of all the items over Total number of items}

**Calculation:**

Let the difference between the average of their production is X

The truck manufactured by K = {108over 360} times 1440 = 432

The truck manufactured by P = {45over 360}times 1440 = 180

The truck manufactured by J = {55over 360}times 1440 = 220

The truck manufactured by M = {18over 360}times 1440 = 72

The average of production of K and P = {432+180over 2}=306

The average of production of J and M = {220+72over 2}=146

The required difference X = 306 - 146 = 160 

**∴ The required result will be 160.**

questions.question: There is a circular path around a sports field. Rahul takes 15 minutes to drive one round of the field, while Anil takes 18 minutes for the same. questions.solution:

Rahul can complete the one round in = 15 minutes

Anil can complete the one round in = 18 minutes

The LCM is the smallest multiple of two or more than two numbers.

⇒ 18 = 2 × 3 × 3

The LCM of (15 and 18) = 2 × 3² × 5 = 90

**∴ The required result will be 90.**

questions.question: A and B started a business with Rs. 15000 and Rs. 30000 respectively. If A and B share profit in the ratio of 1 ∶ 5 respectively, then what is the ratio of the time period of investment for A and B respectively?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Capital ratio A : B = 15000 : 30000 = 1 : 2

Profit ratio A : B = 1 : 5

Time Ratio = (Profit Ratio ÷ Capital Ratio)

Time Ratio A : B = (1 ÷ 1) : (5 ÷ 2) = 1 : 2.5

Time Ratio A : B = 2 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Investment of A (CA) = Rs. 15000

Investment of B (CB) = Rs. 30000

Profit Ratio (PA : PB) = 1 : 5

Formula used: Profit = Capital × Time period

 
 Capital A (Rs. 15000)
 
 Capital B (Rs. 30000)
 
• 
 Profit Ratio (A : B) = 1 : 5
 Time Ratio = (P / C) = (1/1) : (5/2) = 2 : 5

⇒ PA / PB = (CA × TA) / (CB × TB)

⇒ 1 / 5 = (15000 × TA) / (30000 × TB)

⇒ 1 / 5 = (1 × TA) / (2 × TB)

⇒ TA / TB = (1 × 2) / (5 × 1)

⇒ TA / TB = 2 / 5

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Partnership Rule

When two or more people invest capital for different time periods, the profit is shared in the ratio of the product of their capital and time: P₁ : P₂ = C₁T₁ : C₂T₂.

Time Period Ratio Formula

If the profit ratio and capital ratio are known, the time period ratio is found by dividing the profit units by capital units: T₁ : T₂ = (P₁ ÷ C₁) : (P₂ ÷ C₂).

Working vs Sleeping Partner

A working partner manages the business and may receive a fixed salary or commission from the profit before the remaining profit is shared among all partners.</p

questions.question: A mixture contains milk and water in a ratio of 9 ∶ 5. When 6 litres of water is added to this mixture, the ratio of milk and water becomes 9 ∶ 7, Find the quantity of milk in the mixture
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of milk and water in mixture = 9:5

The new ratio after 6 liters of water added = 9:7

**Calculation:**

Let the quantity of milk and water in mixture initially was 9X and 5X respectively.

According to the question

⇒ {9Xover5X +6 }={9over 7}

⇒ 63X = 45X + 54

⇒ 63X - 45X = 54

⇒ 18X = 54

⇒ X = 3

The quantity of water initially = 3 × 9 = 27 liters

**∴ The quantity of milk in the mixture initially was 27 liters.**

questions.question: A man covers half part of a certain distance at 60 km/hr. He covers 40 percent of remaining distance at the speed of 12 km/hr and covers rest of the distance at the speed of 18 km/hr. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation:**

Let, the total distance = 100a

Time taken to cover half of the distance = (50a / 60) = 5a/6 hour

Time taken to cover 40% of the half distance = (40% × 50a) / 12 = 5a/3 hour

Time taken to cover remaining distance = 30a / 18 = 5a / 3 hour

Total time taken = (5a/6 + 5a/3 + 5a/3) = (25a / 6) hour

⇒ Average Speed = 100a / (25a/6) 

⇒ 4 × 6 = 24 km/hr

**∴ The Average speed is 24 km/hr.**
